implementation_constraints: Keep guest BIOS/VMM as mode owner; no direct host writes to BIOS geometry fields.
Preserve current guest font/palette when dimensions remain unchanged.
Any geometry transition must acknowledge actual queried BIOS dimensions before committing host snapshot.
Unrepresentable dimensions must fail before partial application; changing font/mode and then reporting unsupported would require explicit rollback.
Do not infer arbitrary native-window dimensions from standard VGA mode tables.

VM cell provider rejects coordinates outside committed BIOS grid; VIDEO_BEGIN rejects different grid dimensions.
command_screen_apply verifies real BIOS mode, columns, rows and font height before applying; growing host cache alone cannot make resizing correct.
Original vga_func_12 BL30 selects200/350/400 scanlines; ega character-generator AL11/12/14 loads14/8/16px and invokes recalc_text. recalc_text derives rows from actual scanlines.
Existing ResizeCommand changes native buffer to80x50 but retains80x25 viewport; it does not prove actual VM visible-grid resizing.
